messages:
elaine (SEO): quick kickoff — we need a slim, prioritized SEO checklist for the upcoming product + webinar launch. focus: keywords, schema, internal linking, and redirects.

mikey (Content): I can do keywords + meta descriptions. can someone confirm target intent buckets?

elaine (SEO): primary buckets: (1) 'low-latency inference' informational, (2) 'inference cost optimization' commercial intent, (3) 'hosted vs private inference' comparison. aim 1 hero post + 3 supporting pages.

jordan (Web): dev question — do we host the webinar landing under /events/ or /webinars/? prefer folder for long-term canonicalization.

samir (Growth): /webinars/ is cleaner for attribution. UTM rules already expect that. also need a redirect plan from old event URLs.

mikey (Content): ok /webinars/ it is. i'll write hero post titled: "Production LLM Inference: cost, latency, and deployment tradeoffs" (working).

elaine (SEO): redirects: we have a handful of legacy marketing pages that might collide. Jordan, can you run a staging redirect sweep and produce a short `nginx` rule snippet?

jordan (Web): will do. example redirect we'll use for 301s on staging:
```nginx
location = /old-inference-guide {
  return 301 https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference-guide;
}
```

jordan (Web): also adding a canonical header on the hero: `<link rel="canonical" href="https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference-guide">`

elaine (SEO): nice. for schema, include: Webinar, Organization, and HowTo/FAQ where applicable. Mikey — add structured Q&A that maps to the FAQ schema for the webinar page.

mikey (Content): i'll drop 6 FAQs and match each to a keyword phrase. also writing short schema JSON-LD — sample below for the webinar:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Production LLM Inference: Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T16:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference-guide",
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" }
}
```

samir (Growth): tracking: ensure each CTA has campaign params: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=site&utm_campaign=prod_inference_launch`. pass to HubSpot.

elaine (SEO): internal linking plan: hero -> 3 supporting posts (benchmarks, private deploy, cost playbook). each supporting post links back to hero and to each other where contextually relevant. add anchor text map in the doc.

jordan (Web): flag for devs: we need sitemap update and canonical precedence set to hero if duplicates exist. i'll add a deploy check to the release checklist.

seo-bot: Automated crawl check scheduled for staging at 2026-05-01T08:00:00Z — will report 301s, 404s, and duplicate titles.

mikey (Content): one more: meta description drafts in doc for hero + 3 supports. short, ~155 chars. linking + CTA baked in.

elaine (SEO): final preflight list (short):
- confirm keyword targets per page
- JSON-LD schema validated
- redirects (301) mapped & tested on staging
- canonical tags present and correct
- sitemap & robots reviewed
- UTM on CTAs and CRM mapping
- internal linking anchor map added to content doc
- crawl report green from seo-bot

samir (Growth): timeline?

elaine (SEO): tentative: content in by 2026-04-24, staging QA 04-26, deploy 05-01, webinar 05-12. adjust if needed.

jordan (Web): I'll ping when sweep is done, expecting redirect PR by EOD tomorrow.

mikey (Content): got it — will drop keywords + schema into the content doc by EOD today.

elaine (SEO): thanks team. lean, test, launch. :rocket:
